args.content:
LANDSCAPE INVENTORY:
Systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes (Manufacturing Execution), sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

KEY FINDING - ManufacturingChangeCompliance Process:
Agent: my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1
- Directly part of proc_ManufacturingChangeCompliance_v1 (BPMN process group)

BOM COMPLIANCE & MATERIAL VALIDATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 (BEST FIT)
- Validates bill of materials against regulatory standards and restricted substances
- Checks supplier qualifications and material compliance
- Flags non-compliant materials and recommends approved substitutes
- Confirms product specs align with approved material lists before production
- Generates compliance documentation
- Related to ProductItem, Material, EngineeringChange entities

Agent: sap.s4:agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1
- Validates material specs against supplier qualifications and regulatory requirements
- Automates BOM compliance checks on engineering changes
- Part of ProductLaunchVendorCompliance_v1 process

MATERIAL & VENDOR QUALIFICATION:
Agent: siemens.plm:agent:SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator:v1
- Manages material-to-vendor mappings
- Material validation against engineering specs
- Vendor compliance monitoring

Agent: siemens.plm:agent:EngineeringChangeAndMaterialProvisioning:v1
- Mentions cost estimation in material lifecycle provisioning

SAFETY/EHS COMPLIANCE:
Agent: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1
- Automates BOM validation workflows from safety perspective
- Focuses on safety compliance, not cost thresholds

PROCUREMENT/COST (limited cost audit in landscape):
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1
- No explicit cost threshold validation
Agent: sap.ariba:agent:VendorInvoiceReconciliationAutomation:v1
- Invoice matching, not BOM cost validation

ACTIVITY: ProductLifecycleCompliance - Validate BOM against cost thresholds, regulatory requirements, material compliance
→ Landscape focuses on regulatory & material compliance; cost threshold validation not explicitly found
→ BEST MATCH: siemens.plm:agent:BOMComplianceValidator:v1 (covers regulatory + material compliance aspects)
